grammar.title: Starting over with 重新
grammar.explanation: 重新 (chóngxīn) means "again, once more, anew" placed before a verb to say you are redoing something from the start, often because the first try needs improvement. Compare with 再 (simply repeat) and 又 (already happened again).

grammar.title: Habitual actions with 经常
grammar.explanation: 经常 (jīngcháng) means "often, frequently, regularly" it describes a habitual action and goes right before the verb, similar to 常常 but a little more formal.

sentences.en: He often goes to the library.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yào chóngxīn xiě zhège zì.
sentences.en: I need to rewrite this character.
He found a new job, starting over.

sentences.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ chóngxīn shuō yí cì.
sentences.en: Please say it again from the start.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū jiào wǒ nòng huài le.
sentences.en: This book got ruined by me.
